entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: nested native-histogram aggregation input is %T with %s sample kind
entries.rationale: every caller passes a histogram branch produced by lowerExpHistogramValuedShape, lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand, shadowResolveMixedExpHistogramOperands, or a histogram range fold over one of those branches. Those constructors publish HistogramProjection or histogram-flagged VectorSetOp schemas, all SampleKindHistogram, so another kind is an internal producer-contract failure.
